name: Bicske (Hungary)
description: Two equal horizontal stripes of blue over yellow, charged at the centre with the town arms of Bicske: a blue shield with a white charge, with a helm, a horse crest and yellow and blue mantling.
history: Hungarian municipal symbols are adopted by decree of the local representative body (képviselő-testület); the flag carries the colours of the municipal arms.

features.role: Bicske arms with helm, crest and mantling
